1088dcecf624a75713158f8d6d72c2847baf58ab.summary: Technical analysis of SmokeLoader, a malware family of the loader type that the text says was first revealed in 2011. The text says it can serve as a keylogger, information stealer, botnet or backdoor, and that it is spread through email and drive-by downloads. It also says SmokeLoader was the first to use PROPagate injection, which runs code inside a different application from the one that is running. The text is only an introduction excerpt, so it names no actors, sectors, countries, CVEs or figures.

10efc9456f6091cedccf1852f2514a3f7392fb8d.summary: Intel 471 describes The Gentlemen, a data extortion and ransomware group active since August 2025 that it says has claimed hundreds of victims. The report says the group typically gets in through compromised credentials or exposed VPN and firewall services, maps the network, disables security tools using a vulnerable signed driver, shuts down backup services, exfiltrates data, and deploys ransomware through the NETLOGON share. It also presents a behavioural hunt for accounts added to privileged Windows groups, run in Splunk.

Delivery is by watering-hole compromise, with gambling and fake crypto-exchange lure pages. GTIG attributes the operation to UNC6691 and documented more delivery domains than the analysed sample. The chain covers WebKit memory primitives, PAC bypass, JIT cage escape, and a kernel bug, CVE-2023-41974 in IOSurfaceRoot. The report says the activity had the hallmarks of the C0d0s0 group, which it describes as Chinese hackers for hire. Threat intelligence firm Area 1, founded by three former NSA analysts, installed a sensor, tracked the activity, blocked some attacks and warned some victims. 10a3152db508b958e136fcd1f7dc17c089c3c148.summary: CERT-UA reports that Sandworm, a state-sponsored Russian group the report says is linked to Russia's GRU, compromised eleven Ukrainian telecommunication providers between May and September 2023. Access reportedly came via exposed RDP or SSH, unprotected VPN accounts and web-service flaws. Backdoors Poemgate and Poseidon were seen, along with proxies, log deletion, service disruption against Mikrotik equipment, and backup wiping. The figures rest on public resources and information from some breached providers.
